summary: The Python SDK provides development tooling for App Engine standard Python applications.
extended_definition: The Python SDK provides development tooling for App Engine standard Python applications.

supporting_pages.title: "Access legacy bundled services for Python 3 \_|\_ App Engine standard environment\
evidence_snippets: For example: python3 CLOUD SDK ROOT / bin / dev appserver . py -- runtime python path = "python27=/user/bin/python2.7,python3=/usr/bin/python3" Important: When using the local development server to test Python 3 apps that use the Deferred API , you must set the following environment variable in your app.yaml : DEFERRED USE CROSS COMPATIBLE PICKLE PROTOCOL: 'True' Pickle Compatibility Shared services including Memcache, Cloud NDB and deferred use the pickle module to serialize and share Python objects.
To locally test the legacy bundled services functionality in your Python 3 app, use the local development server .
Testing Important: Before running the local development server, follow the setup instructions .
